description: This file contains unit tests for the CloudStore plugin, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests various JSON-RPC methods such as getValue, setValue, deleteKey, deleteNamespace, and their interactions with mocked implementations of CloudStore, focusing on account scope operations.
